activity.notes: ATLAS uses Athelstan's crowned English kingship from 925 to 939. Sources sometimes label the succession year as 924, but the Royal Family narrative itself gives his reign as 925-939 and describes the subsequent consolidation of the English kingdom.

sources.title: Athelstan (r.924-939) — The Royal Family
sources.citation_text: The Royal Family narrative states that Athelstan reigned 925-939 and describes his consolidation and expansion of the English kingdom.
